financial_transactions_sign_check.name: financial_transactions_sign_check
financial_transactions_sign_check.value:
("financial_transactions"."transaction_type" IN (1, 3, 5) AND "financial_transactions"."amount" > 0) OR
    ("financial_transactions"."transaction_type" IN (2, 4, 6, 7) AND "financial_transactions"."amount" < 0) OR
    "financial_transactions"."transaction_type" = 8

inventory_transactions_sign_check.name: inventory_transactions_sign_check
inventory_transactions_sign_check.value:
(
    ("inventory_transactions"."transaction_type" IN (1, 4, 8) AND "inventory_transactions"."quantity_in_base_unit" > 0) OR
    ("inventory_transactions"."transaction_type" IN (2, 3, 5, 7) AND "inventory_transactions"."quantity_in_base_unit" < 0) OR
    ("inventory_transactions"."transaction_type" = 6 AND "inventory_transactions"."quantity_in_base_unit" <> 0)
  ) AND "inventory_transactions"."unit_cost" >= 0 AND "inventory_transactions"."quantity_in_base_unit" * "inventory_transactions"."total_cost" >= 0

social_rules_limits_check.name: social_rules_limits_check
social_rules_limits_check.value: ("social_automation_rules"."cooldown_minutes" IS NULL OR "social_automation_rules"."cooldown_minutes" >= 0) AND ("social_automation_rules"."max_executions_per_day" IS NULL OR "social_automation_rules"."max_executions_per_day" > 0) AND ("social_automation_rules"."max_executions_per_food_per_day" IS NULL OR "social_automation_rules"."max_executions_per_food_per_day" > 0)

support_messages_sender_identity_check.name: support_messages_sender_identity_check
support_messages_sender_identity_check.value:
("support_messages"."sender_type" = 1 AND "support_messages"."customer_profile_id" IS NOT NULL AND "support_messages"."admin_user_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("support_messages"."sender_type" = 2 AND "support_messages"."admin_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "support_messages"."customer_profile_id" IS NULL)
